# Speaker detection fixture

`speaker-portrait.jpg` is a crop of a public-domain NASA portrait of Eileen Collins distributed with scikit-image. The [scikit-image data documentation](https://scikit-image.org/docs/stable/api/skimage.data.html#skimage.data.astronaut) lists the source photograph and its public-domain status. The fixture verifies offline face detection with real image data. It contains no pilot captures.
